notes.title: Fog Of War Update Out Now
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

[b]We are excited to announce that the Fog of War (our Biggest update yet!) is now available![/b]

[h2]Update Breakdown[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Trailer
[*]Exploration Drone & Fog of War
[*]Improved Crafting
[*]Shipping Depot
[*]Rewarding Objectives
[*]Challenges
[*]Improved Tutorial
[*]Bug Fixes & Other Improvements
[/list]

[h2]New Trailer[/h2]
You can find our new Fog of War Update Trailer Here!
[previewyoutube=eDaT9X1aFHA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Exploration Drone & Fog of War[/h2]
Explore the map and uncover the fog of war with your new Drone! The exploration drone is unlocked by completing objectives. The drone main uses is to find resources outside your starting area. Also, you cannot purchase land tiles that are fully covered by the fog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/e8262efabd7635859d087dd5890ae76ad83bb47a.gif[/img]

The drone has a battery and charges itself with its own solar panels. All you need to do is set waypoints by entering world coordinates.

[h2]Improved Crafting[/h2]

We have completely remade the crafting tool from the ground up! To read more about all the crafting changes, please see the devlog [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1447710/view/3350135361884636966]HERE.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/139d45a6898666f7b19717dc41964cc6e9abcf2e.gif[/img]

[h2]Shipping Depot[/h2]
The Shipping Depot is a new building which you start with which acts as the central place for everything that involves shipping. The Shipping Depot is the new home for Market Orders, Selling items to the market, and completing contracts.

You now get paid out for contracts when the contract is being picked up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/0fbd705bf052cc4787cc7b41033a3626d2a0bc79.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/d61ca2933e7e335fd9e26ec1e4ebf271dc887d9e.gif[/img]

[h2]Reward Objectives[/h2]
The in-game objectives have been remade with new SFX, animations and 13 new objectives to complete. Plus, completing them unlocks tools, money and items as a reward. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/849fdfc47910b8614c7ca36eaad8e856107c2f3e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/ed28ae162e6ea266e3710b45edabba514092a35f.gif[/img]

[h2]Challenges[/h2]
When starting a game, you now have the option to turn on up to 5 different challenges. These challenges include:
[list]
[*]Windy - Wind will never go below 80km/h (49mph)
[*]No Warnings - All warnings are disabled and cannot be enabled.
[*]No Worker Skills - Workers will not be able to increase their skills.
[*]Eco Conscious - Cannot operate Coal Heaters and Coal Generators (you will be given two turbines and a battery at the start of the game)
[*]No Pausing - The pause button is disabled.
[/list]

[h2]Improved Tutorial[/h2]
The in-game tutorial has been updated to hopefully be less force full and more helpful! There are new short tutorial videos to provide a more visual experience. The skip tutorial option are more obvious and frequent and you are never forced to open a menu because of a tutorial.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Other Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now toggle the visibility of each Warning / Urgent Type
[*]Weekly Targets now only start on Week 2
[*]Additional Loans available in the Payment History Tab
[*]When moving items, you now see outlines and info of where you can insert an item into (for example: inserting an item into Storage or adding Fuel to a Coal Heater)
[*]You will now receive a message at the bottom of the screen which will describe to you the reason you cannot do a certain action. (For example: you cannot craft this item because you are missing this ingredient)
[*]Separated the Bakery into its own building
[*]Manage Food Supply (Limit what workers can consume for plants)
[*]Increase starting area from 10x10 to 12x12
[*]Increased Range and Effectiveness of both Wooden Walls and Wind Diverging Walls
[*]Add Keybinding for the Automation tab
[*]Contracts now display when the next contracts will be available
[*]Keybindings now work when in moving tab
[*]Show keybinding below each tool button
[*]Added separate volume slider for weather SFX
[*]Everyone starts the game with a seed of each plant
[*]Utility Menu now displays the qty remaining of a item (ex: power cable, water pipes)
[*]Hide ULines and Utility Gates until unlocked
[*]Contracts now require to be researched before they can be used
[*]Improved Worker Skill Notification in Emails
[*]Email reminder when new Contracts are available
[*]When a worker dies, you lose contract company reputation
[*]Lowered the time to grow trees in the Automatic Tree Farm (400 to 260)
[*]Contract Completion Result now shows in Emails
[*]Fixed Loading and Saving Times (now much faster)
[*]Other Game Improvements made
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed many issues with the ingame tutorial not working as intended
[*]Fixed issue where resetting the default controls did not fix duplicated key bindings indicators
[*]Fixed a bug with Contract Renewal not working properly
[*]Fix Game not pausing when entering the Escape Menu
[*]Fix Farm Production Speed when workers have higher levels
[*]Other small game fixes made
[/list]

notes.title: Rewarding Objectives & Challenges - Sept 2022 Devlog
notes.content:
September 2022 Devlog,

[h3]Welcome to the 3rd Devlog which covers all the new and improved features of the Fog of War Major Update.[/h3] 
If you haven't seen the previous two devlogs, make sure to check out the ones from August and June 2022!

[h2]Rewarding Objectives[/h2]
The Rewarding Objectives will be replacing the very outdated Objective System. The old objectives only provided 4 objectives which were mere suggestions to guide the player at the start of the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/849fdfc47910b8614c7ca36eaad8e856107c2f3e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/849fdfc47910b8614c7ca36eaad8e856107c2f3e.gif[/img][/url]

NOW, the Rewarding Objectives feature [b]13[/b] objectives and which unlocks tools and provide cash / item rewards after completing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/d796a6b330b2cb615d1d832a2ae22de394169bf3.gif[/img]

The objectives will help introduce different game mechanics to the player by only providing a couple of tools at the start of the game instead of giving the player everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/ed28ae162e6ea266e3710b45edabba514092a35f.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Challenges[/h2]
We have added 5 new challenges to spice up the difficulty. The Challenges will be available when starting a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/a33c6e55f1bf2427eef33f473076ce973b757f8b.gif[/img]

[b]Here are the 5 Challenges:[/b]
[list]
[*]Windy - Wind will never go below 80km/h (49mph)
[*]No Warnings - All warnings are disabled and cannot be enabled.
[*]No Worker Skills - Workers will not be able to increase their skills.
[*]Eco Conscious - Cannot operate Coal Heaters and Coal Generators (you will be given two turbines and a battery at the start of the game)
[*]No Pausing - The pause button is disabled.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
The Fog of War update will feature an additional starting building called "Shipping Depot". This will serve as a central place to sell / receive items from the Market and to sent items for Contracts. More information about the Shipping Depot will be available in the next Devlog.

The Fog of War update will hopefully be ready for end October to start of November. I apologise for the delay as this update was anticipated to be released by the end of Summer 2022. 

[u][b]Fog of War will most likely be the largest update yet.[/b][/u]

Thank you and have a great day!

notes.title: Complete Crafting Revamp / Bakery / Other - August 2022 Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Good day Survivors![/b]

Welcome to our August 2022 Devlog! Today we'll be discussing some exciting features which will be available in the upcoming major update: Fog of War. The Fog of War update release date will be announced soon, but we are targeting around the end of September / October of 2022. 

[h1]Complete Crafting Revamp[/h1]
Yes, the crafting mechanic has been rebuilt from the ground up! No more trying to find where your item has spawned when crafting. Now, you will be able to choose where the crafted item will be placed. There are many other differences which will be discussed below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/051e05b96ee13f7054937eeec016cc04a7abfb0c.gif[/img]

[h2]Crafting Modes[/h2]
There are two modes in the Crafting menu: MINE and CRAFT

[h3]MINE[/h3]
The MINING tool is used to convert resources into usable materials. For example, clicking on a tree will turn it into wooden planks. You will also be able to visually see that the interactible tiles will be in green and the tiles which you can’t do anything with will be in red.
As always, large resources can only be mined with a Mining rig.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/9679d68078983b445ea5e8011feb4818f236d1fe.gif[/img]

[h3]CRAFT[/h3]
As you might have guessed, this tool allows you to craft items. First, you need to navigate to the CraftOPedia to ‘equip’ items that you want to craft into your Recipe Hotbar. To craft an item, open the crafting menu, select an item from your recipe hotbar, then click on the space where you want to place it in the world.
You can now see how much of each item in the crafting recipe you currently have available. Also, the crafting tool will automatically use items around the world and in storage for the crafting recipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/c5ae731c4c49e709e9c83c9f4a1bb47a0a7ab1c6.png[/img]

[h2]Drilling Down the Crafting Recipe[/h2]
Instead of equipping all items you need to craft a building in the Recipe Hotbar, you can click on an item within the crafting recipe to bring up its recipe. For example, a FarmHut required a wooden structure to be built. Instead of equipping both items in the Recipe Hotbar, you can simply equip the Farm Hut. Once the FarmHut is selected in the crafting menu, you can craft the wooden structure by clicking on its image.
Once the wooden structure is built, the game will automatically bring you back to the previous recipe (which would be the Farm Hut).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/139d45a6898666f7b19717dc41964cc6e9abcf2e.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements to CraftOPedia, Again[/h2]
This should be the final overhaul for the CraftOPedia. We have made an entirely new section where you can view exactly where an item can be made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/9ed9e4f1ad2c06e67b46aea71103b847e2437b7c.gif[/img]

[h1]Bakery[/h1]
Bakeries are now their own building. It is no longer part of the FarmHut and Greenhouse. It functions the same as Factories and Assembly Machines. 

You can now manage how much of each ingredient is set aside for Bakeries. This prevents workers from consuming it before it can be used to make baked goods.
Farms can now be used with Links (Automation).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/a9ec6dd11a78905d136744aa942d3da1faa970ac.png[/img]

[h2]Where can I Move Items to?[/h2]
[b]Quality Of Life[/b] - The game now displays where you can insert an item while moving them. For example, when moving Coal, you will see a indicator of 'FUEL' on top of every item that requires Coal for fuel (like Coal Heaters and Coal Generators).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/72850f56a229938182d7487f8de0e4fb8a5a8bcc.gif[/img]

You can read the June 2022 Devlog to view more features regarding the Fog of War update.


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We have a few more features planned for the Fog of War update. Such as introducing 'Rewarding Objectives' which will replace the current outdated Objectives. 
We will also introduce Challenges which will add another level of difficulty to the game. More info on these features in the next Devlog

notes.title: June 2022 Devlog - Fog Of War & Exploration Drone
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Survivors,[/h3]

I would like to take this opportunity to talk about what is currently being worked on in Death By FrostByte!
These features and improvements will be available in the next update!

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Fog Of War[/h3]
We are currently experimenting with Fog Of War which will hide the entire map except for the starting area. You will be given an "Exploration Drone" which you can use to slowly uncover the map! The drone works by inserting coordinates for it to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/e8262efabd7635859d087dd5890ae76ad83bb47a.gif[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/e385f1fa29739ba1771078f261087eac4c216d91.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/cffbef3ac8d83892cd35c4208c226fed796aae43.png[/img]

The drone will have a light during the night. It will also require time to charge its battery. There will be upgrades available to speed up its exploration time and charge rate.
Also, you can't buy land that is completely hidden. Buying land will clear all partial fog of war on it.

[h3]Toggling Specific Warnings[/h3]

The next update will include some new improvements to the warning system. First, the warning panel at the top left side of the screen has gotten a makeover to match the theme of the other panels.

You will now be able to enable each warning type, or even have the option to toggle the entire warning system On or Off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/3b4b875fddb5930439ba634592adbf94e021a72c.png[/img]

[b]These are all the new features so far. However, there will be more new content that will be announced in the next Devlog![/b]

[h2]Game Improvements / Quality Of Life[/h2]

[h3]Refining the Utility Tool Menu[/h3]

- Added a new counter which represents how much of the current utility (for example: Power Cables) is available to place.
- The Underground Lines and Gates button are hidden until they are unlocked via research. 
- Moved the button which opens a panel that list all circuits. This "Overview" button is now much easier to find than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/b4e31e9966346d2af102b398885e01a4a7bbfb93.png[/img]

[h3]In-game Tutorial[/h3]

- If you accidentally leave the in-game tutorial enabled when starting a new game, you are now greeted with an option to "SKIP ALL" tutorials once you are loaded.
- All tutorials now have the options to be closed.
- Moved the tutorial panels to the bottom left corner of the screen instead of having it in the middle of the screen.
- You are no longer forced to interact with a specific element when going through the in-game tutorial.
- Fixed one tutorial panel which was assuming the player has already built the coal-generator.
- The in-game tutorial is still not completely revised and more improvements are expected to come!

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
- The starting area is now 44 tiles larger! It used to be an area of 10x10, now its 12x12.
- You are now guaranteed 2 of each resource type when starting a new game.
- You can now move items while being paused.
- You only get one email a day now for new worker skills. (Before it was one email every time someone obtained a new skill)
- You are now alerted when new contracts are available
- Both the Wooden Walls and Wind Diverging Walls have better range and wind reduction.
- Fixed and issue with the Pinned items displaying an item recipe when starting a new game.

[b]More to come![/b]

Thank you for playing Death by FrostByte and have a great day!

notes.title: v0.15 Update Notes - Fahrenheit & Craft-O-Pedia Redesign & Other Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Survivors[/h3]
Today we are releasing another update which includes the full soundtrack, many improvements and bug Fixes.

[h2]Update Features (v0.15a)[/h2]

[h3]Fahrenheit & MPH[/h3]
Now you can change the weather measurements to Fahrenheit and MPH in the settings. This is a small addition to the game but will greatly increase your experience if you are accustomed with the imperial measurements. The metric measurements are still the default.

[h3]CraftOPedia Redesign[/h3]
The CraftOPedia has been completely redesigned to give the player more impactful information on each item. You can now see items that are locked by research.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/8b2c2f74d8b24e07c155e35d5a8238c4f84079fc.png[/img]

[h3]Emails[/h3]
We have created emails as a way to provide information to the player without it being intrusive. For example, we have removed the Market Recap menu that pops up at the end of the day. Instead, you will receive an email which you can view at any time. You will also receive emails about your workers and other events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/b651218621edd4d4c21b335449b418d48aca9d96.png[/img]
[h3]Navigate Through Pinned Crafting Recipes[/h3]
If you have a complex crafting recipe, instead of pinning each crafting level, you can now navigate up and down each crafting recipe from the crafting tool! This feature was suggested by our steam community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/05f1c420ed877418de8858bdad444a075cec36ef.gif[/img]

[h3]Events - Phase 1[/h3]
This update will feature an introduction on game events. You will experience every few days that an item in the Market will have its price skyrocket due to "short supplies".

There will be more events and lore added to the game in the future!

[h3]Game Improvements & Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added about 15 minutes of new music, remastered the existing music tracks
[*]Reduced the item quantity from all contract sizes
[*]Increased the length of most research tasks
[*]Have workers start with less skills, (have max set in one 3)
[*]Workers take longer to earn new skills
[*]Reduced loan payment increase: 2000 > 1000
[*]Reduced cost increase when buying land: 60 > 50
[*]Reduced max cost of land: 40000 > 20000
[*]Saving game now takes much less time
[*]Raised max capacity of a power cable: 16kW > 20kW
[*]Raised max capacity of a heavy duty power cable: 40kW > 50kW
[*]You can now hold the Increase or Decrease amount buttons to speed up the changing number
[*]Expand view around the map borders, you can now have a better view items near the map edge
[*]Allow camera movement (WASD) when in storage transfer
[*]Display max output on Solar Panels
[*]Added more details in the world outside of the playable area
[*]Music track will unique for 8 tracks at a time (used to be 2)
[*]Prioritize the main colony storage unit for random transfers (especially for food items)
[*]Delay the music start when loading into the game
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with SFX volume (both ingame and in the main menu)
[*]Fixed glitch with inserting coal in another item (Coal Generator) while only having 1kg left
[*]Muted SFX while in the loading game scene
[*]Fixed the land expansion tool glitching out after buying land
[*]Fixed issue where the difficulty would change from its first picked option when loading in a save
[*]Cancel Link Setup when exiting setup
[*]Fixed issue that you could not cancel a link if the placement criteria did not pass
[*]Don't allow items to be deposit into storage unit when frozen
[*]Fixed weekly revenue target showing the wrong amount after loading a save
[*]Fixed issues caused by the UnfreezeCrew
[*]Fixed issue were workers would not get a new item to unfreeze in the Unfreeze Crew
[*]Mining production amount text not automatically updated in Mining Rig
[*]Fixed bug where not all coal operated items get 40kg of coal when crafted
[*]Fixed bug with the shipping container not spawning
[*]Fixed snow buildup on items not saved
[*]Fixed Glitch where sometimes the status bar of the water tank stays when moving the item
[*]Fixed issue with circuit overloading not working properly (items where still receiving power)
[*]Fixed: When building wooden walls with material covered in snow, only one of them is affected by the snow slowdown (both should be affected)
[*]Fixed other issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Death By FrostByte OST Coming Soon & Spring 2022 Devlog
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Survivors, we have some exciting news for you today![/h3]

[h2]Official Soundtrack DLC Release[/h2]
We are excited to announce the full release of the Death By FrostByte soundtrack which will be available on Steam on [b]May 24th[/b]! The soundtrack has been composed by Gōst Pepper with additional performances by Mia Asano on violin and electric violin, and Kelsey Blackstone on cello.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807350/Death_By_FrostByte_Official_Soundtrack/][b]Don't forget to add the OST DLC on your wishlist![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/92ef2887239729b599618e24f742501fed0d2642.png[/img]

[h2]Next Update[/h2]
The next Death By FrostByte update will be on May 24th as well. Here are some key features that will be included in our upcoming update.

[h3]CraftOPedia Redesign[/h3]
The CraftOPedia has been completely redesigned to give the player more impactful information on each item. You can now see items that are locked by research.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/8b2c2f74d8b24e07c155e35d5a8238c4f84079fc.png[/img]

[h3]Emails[/h3]
We have created emails as a way to provide information to the player without it being intrusive. For example, we have removed the Market Recap menu that pops up at the end of the day. Instead, you will receive an email which you can view at any time. You will also receive emails about your workers and other events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/b651218621edd4d4c21b335449b418d48aca9d96.png[/img]
[h3]Navigate Through Pinned Crafting Recipes[/h3]
If you have a complex crafting recipe, instead of pinning each crafting level, you can now navigate up and down each crafting recipe from the crafting tool! This feature was suggested by our steam community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/05f1c420ed877418de8858bdad444a075cec36ef.gif[/img]

[h3]Lore / Story / Events[/h3]
This update will feature an introduction on game events. You will experience every few days that an item in the Market will have its price skyrocket due to "short supplies".

We are also in the process of writing "Climate Crisis" journals which will paint the picture of the current environment and what has happened in the past. These journals might not make it to this update but we will be providing more info on them in the future.

notes.title: Death By FrostByte - August 2021 Devlog
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Ice Age Survivors![/h3]

We hope you had a great summer and enjoyed our newest update [b]Frozen Water[/b]. In this devlog we will be sharing with you the new features and content that we've been working on over the last month for the next update.

[h3]Autosaves[/h3]
The first feature that we have added is autosaves! You can choose to have the game saved after every day, two days, week or you can turn the feature off in the settings.

[h2]New Items[/h2]

We have added several new items to the game! Here is the list:

- [b]Compact Storage[/b] : Store more items compared to the regular storage unit while only taking up one tile.
- [b]Automatic Tree Farm[/b] : Produces an endless supply of wooden plants but requires one worker, electricity and water.
- [b]Large Solar Panel[/b] : Produce more power with solar energy. Takes up two tiles.
- [b]Tall Turbine[/b] : Just like the small turbines, it produces power with wind except it is not affected by wind walls! Plus, it produces a little more power than the small turbines.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/7f402a7027aff1f7dac7a17b1502a5d17c4c5ada.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/7f402a7027aff1f7dac7a17b1502a5d17c4c5ada.gif[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/f95c1e89c0fff8e0aa98166ffe280f58867d56ef.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sprite Redesign[/h3]

On another note, we have also redesigned the sprites of a couple of our already existing items. All plants have been redesigned along with the small solar panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/a083ddcbb9091e1ca0708f35412be30866e5f5dd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Workers Overhaul[/h3]

There will be many changes to the workers in the next update. This include workers skills (how fast they can complete a task, like research or farming). A shift management system will be added where workers will need time to sleep. As of right now we are working on adding workers portraits.

Workers portraits will make it easier to differentiate who is who. Here are a couple of examples:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/d6daeb9353da756ef0d0f8634cd7d0d5c97c2243.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/493f1ae6b86e8687a049d83665461400ed10d7f2.png[/img]

[h3]Game Intro[/h3]

Lastly, we are working on an intro sequence to give the player an idea of the backstory. It is still very early in the works but here are a couple previews of possible scenes for the intro:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/7745aab5d9b2c7cf664f9bec4d7e931b7a68faff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/b166ce41d127ec983d17291ef19506e25d21f15f.jpg[/img]

Don't forget to follow us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/StormeeGames]TWITTER[/url][/b] for regular development updates. Also,[b] [url=https://discord.gg/6aVamXK3ks]CLICK HERE[/url][/b] to join our Discord Server!

Have a great day!

Stormee Games

notes.content:
[h2]Frozen Water Update - 1st MAJOR UPDATE - v0.13.5a[/h2]

Hello Survivors,

We are excited to announce that Death By FrostByte first major update, Frozen Water Update is now available to play! The game will be 15% off for the first week!

[previewyoutube=QW9_hqhg6fA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Features & Content[/h3]

[list]
[u][b]Added 8 Utility Items[/b][/u]
[*]Water Pipes (Heated / Regular)
[*]Large Water Pipes (Heated / Regular)
[*]Heavy Duty Cables
[*]Underground Lines
[*]Utility Gates
[*]Water Pump

[b][u]Utilities Overhaul[/u][/b]
[*]Added Water as a Utility Type
[*]Circuits are now color coded
[*]Rename Circuits
[*]Circuits now have a max load; power circuits can now be overloaded
[*]Water Circuits can freeze
[*]Houses and Farms have integrated water tanks
[*]Buildings requiring water now needs to be connected via water pipes
[*]View the temperature map while working with utilities
[*]Pass circuits through each other with Underground Lines
[*]Combine circuits together with Utility Gates
[*]New circuits can now be created by adding cables on an empty tile
[*]Added Force production option for Water Pumps and Coal Generators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/abe2a3dd587b636c22b8159c6233a01ea82ea572.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/f894122d7b8a12734e6ed6d1a1e5df881e30cda3.png[/img]


[b][u]Snow Storms[/u][/b]
[*]Added Snow Storms
[*]Added Signal Loss for Market, Workers Applications, and Available Contracts during storms
[*]Added Snow Buildup (takes longer to craft items)
[*]Added new SFX (circuit overload, water pump, circuit reset)
[*]Added new upgrade: Better Antennas (stops signal loss during storms).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/f16931eba946c504ebfeeb7559369b4cf54f95c3.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Tutorials / Manual[/b][/u]
[*]Added Interactive Tutorials (Overview Tutorial, Crafting Basics, Utilities Basics)
[*]Added 2 new pages in the manual based on Utilities.
[*]Added Key Binding guide when starting new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/fbec903c442c7ff2e62ef3adf691bcceeada721e.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
[*]Added 2 New Music Tracks
[*]Added Weekly Targets (revenue targets and weekly loan payments)


[h3]Game Improvements[/h3]
[*]Complete revamp of Water Tank (Water can freeze inside tank, tank no longer generates water, now includes an internal heater)
[*]Removed the New Circuit Button.
[*]Reorganized main menu
[*]Added Loading scene
[*]Increased the amount of quantity there is in large resources.
[*]Added new Environmental SFX based on the current weather.
[*]Added new Day / Night environmental visual effects.
[*]Lower cost of land tiles.
[*]You can now modify the automation label of storage units.
[*]Added small water pockets throughout the world.
[*]Revamped the circuits overview menu.
[*]Performance: Complete item sprite overhaul.


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*]Fixed Assembly Machine and Factory displaying items to craft that was still locked via researched.
[*]Fixed the next page button still showing up on the last page of the Craft-O-Pedia.
[*]Fixed Contracts including Wind Diverging wall when item was still locked.
[*]Fixed issue when checking items inside storage units when one or more is frozen. (For example: Farm not finding any seeds when there are clearly available seeds in storage)
[*]Fixed Input Field being modified when not selecting it in the Factory and Assembly Machine menu.
[*]Fixed Coal Heater warning about NO FUEL not stopping after turning item off.
[*]Fixed Power Icons disappearing.

[/list]

Saves from the previous version (v0.12.7a) will not be compatible with the new update due to heavy construction that the game is currently experiencing. You can find a guide on how to change the game version [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2544614667]HERE[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/4VdZzJrcCd]CLICK HERE[/url] to join the Death By FrostByte discord server.[/b]

We hope you enjoy this update!

Stormee Games

notes.title: Automation Update & Game Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[h3]Automation & Links[/h3]
The automation update adds a new key item to the game, links! Links are used to automating the task of moving items from one machine to another. With links, you can automatically fill Coal Heaters and Generators, organize Storage Units, create chains of Assembly Machines to automate crafting, and more.
There are currently two types of links in the game: Regular links and Filter Links.

The only downside of links is that they only span up to a distance of 4 tiles. This is where rails will eventually come into play (which will be added in a future update).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/15399a1b83bbd748092f21d655ae2aed0391da7b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Rework of the in-game Manual[/h3]
The manual has been reworked and improved to clarify some step-by-step processes on setting up power lines, automation, and more! The in-game manual has been expanded to cover Contracts, Automation / Links, and functionality with Assembly Machines and Factories.

[h3]More Heaters & Coal Generators[/h3]
We have added two new heaters and one new coal generator to the game. In addition, temperature sensors have been added to both new heaters. This allows you to set what temperature you want the heater to start operating at.

[h3]Other New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Basic Tree Farm
[*]Added 11 Steam Achievements
[*]Added 2 new music tracks
[*]Added New Research: Industry 2
[*]And More!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39047380/ceab9e49bec05a15062c1e5ca5a232c1cc284786.jpg[/img]

[h2]When will the game be released?[/h2]
We are getting ever so close to the release of Death By FrostByte Early Access! Before we can release the game there is one last piece of content we want to implement into the game, a new Weather System. The current weather system maxes out at ~30 days. However, we want to extend the max day count to the hundreds if not the thousands. Also, this will ease up on the freezing temperature at the start of the game.

We are looking at releasing the game around mid-March of this year, and will most likely announce a set release date by the first week of March!

Thank you and have a great day!

Stormee Games
Eric
